## Index info

The Bloomberg Asian-Pacific Aggregate Index contains fixed-rate, investment-grade securities denominated in Japanese yen, Australian dollar, Hong Kong dollar, Malaysian ringgit, Indonesian ruppiah, New Zealand dollar, Singapore dollar, South Korean won and Thai baht. Inclusion is based on currency of the issue and not the country of risk of the issuer. (Legacy Ticker: LAPCTRJU)
